headline: Fresh Clashes Erupt Across Marban Hollow as Northern Fronts Intensify
war_summary: Since the late-evening dispatch, combat operations have re-ignited around fortified strongpoints in Marban Hollow, Nevish Line, and Weathered Expanse, breaking the recent lull with fresh base exchanges. Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua in Marban Hollow recorded active shifts leading into the midnight watch, alongside renewed clashes around Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way in Nevish Line. Meanwhile, Stonecradle has experienced a sharp escalation, where casualty rates surged abruptly over the past two hours under heavy fighting. In Callahan’s Passage, attritional combat grinds on unabated, tallying upwards of two thousand casualties within two hours even as regional lines hold firm. Weathered Expanse likewise endures heavy reciprocal losses around Spirit Watch, yielding late base turnovers in disputed sectors. While earlier flashpoints in Linn of Mercy and Godcrofts have cooled without recent territorial exchanges, the central front through Palantine Berm remains heavily bloodied, keeping garrisons locked in a fierce standoff.
